summary.en: Israeli drones struck a Syrian operative near the Lebanon border who was planning attacks for Iran, and also wounded six people in Lebanon in a separate attack. Houthi forces carried out a deadly strike on Saudi Arabia's Riyadh airport, prompting condemnation from Damascus. UN News reported intensified Israeli incursions in Syria alongside the ongoing conflict. The conflict caused 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Israels droner slo ned en syrisk operativ nær Libanon‑grensen som planla angrep for Iran, og såret også seks personer i Libanon i et separat angrep. Houthi‑styrker gjennomførte et dødelig angrep på Riyadh‑flyplassen i Saudi‑Arabia, noe som førte til fordømmelse fra Damaskus. FN‑nyheter rapporterte om intensiverte israelske inntrengninger i Syria parallelt med den pågående konflikten. Konflikten forårsaket 2 732 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
